d295ddbd40.q: What is the Therapist Evolution Summit and what topics does it cover for mental health professionals?
d295ddbd40.a: The Therapist Evolution Summit is a conference being held in Seattle in August with approximately 300 attendees, featuring 18 speakers covering business growth and diversification for therapists. Topics include retreats, artificial intelligence, group practice ownership, continuing education courses, intensives, professional speaking, financial planning, book writing, marketing, and practice valuation. The summit is designed specifically for therapists wanting to develop multiple revenue streams beyond traditional therapy while maintaining their professional integrity.

3ed3f52630.q: Why did Arilda Surridge create the Therapist Evolution Summit instead of just continuing retreats?
3ed3f52630.a: Arilda wanted to spice up her life and create something new beyond her successful retreat business. After attending a symposium in Washington D.C., she conceived the idea of a larger-scale summit focused on business growth and diversification. She approached Julian to co-host because she recognized that a summit of this scale (aiming for 300 people) required collaboration and could not be managed alone, whereas her retreats had been smaller scale projects she could handle independently.
